quests.title: The Book at Birrong
quests.blurb: I run a small book on things that are not races — weather, delays, whether the just gone midnight out of Birrong runs on time. Somebody is beating it by information, not luck. Ride the run they ride.

steps.label: ride the run they ride
the two who follow you off it
$72 back off the book

quests.title: Last Service out of ES Marks
quests.blurb: Nothing runs out of ES Marks after the back of seven. I lock this end and someone off the 8:02 locks the other and in between there is a kilometre of lit platform for nobody. Ride the last one to Kensington and bring me a photograph of that.

steps.label: ride the late one to Kensington
the empty platform, lit and pointless
tell them what you saw

quests.title: The Tallawong Tap-Off
quests.blurb: Somebody taps on at Tallawong at just gone midnight and never taps off. Same card, 13 months running. Ride the run they ride and find where a person gets off this network without a gate seeing them.

steps.label: ride the run the card rides
the gap in the fence everyone knows about
photograph it before somebody welds it

quests.title: The Engadine Order
quests.blurb: I have made the same order for the same person every morning since I opened at Engadine. Since Thursdays they have not turned up, and I am past being reasonable about it. Go and knock.

steps.label: order one at the Engadine kiosk
the office they walk to, or used to
come back with $60 — I am not running a charity

quests.title: Four Minutes at Glenbrook
quests.blurb: The board at Glenbrook says four minutes. It has said four minutes since before the merge and it is a lie about a third of the time. Stand under it, time it, and bring me numbers instead of feelings.

steps.label: stand under the board and wait like everyone else
photograph the board saying four minutes
ride the one that finally comes
give me the number

quests.title: Unclaimed at UNSW Anzac Parade
quests.blurb: Somebody lost something off the UNSW Anzac Parade line on grand final week and has not come for it, which never happens. Find out why not.

steps.label: the address on the tag
the two who got there before you
$88 — whatever it is, it is worth that to somebody

quests.title: The Quiet Carriage, Redfern
quests.blurb: Speakerphone. The week of the show, Redfern to town, speakerphone. I have made eye contact eleven times and it has achieved nothing.

steps.label: ride the quiet carriage and observe the crime
apply the shame manually
photograph the sign, for the record

quests.title: The Heathcote Shortcut
quests.blurb: Nine minutes between the shortcut at Heathcote and the long way, and nine minutes is four drops. Since every second Friday there has been a padlock on it, and it has been like that since the merge.

steps.label: the end they lock
the long way round, so you understand what it costs
$99, which is what the long way costs me a week

quests.title: Possession at Waterloo
quests.blurb: We own the track between midnight and four and in that window we are the only people in this city doing anything real. Somebody keeps walking through my possession at Waterloo. Find them before a grinder does.

steps.label: where they come through the fence
the ones who think a hard hat is a costume
photograph the gap so I can put a number on the form

quests.title: The Yennora Regular
quests.blurb: A man drank in my front bar by Yennora for 12 years and then stopped, and every regular in here has gone vague on me at once, which means they know. You are not from here. Go and knock.

steps.label: the house they say he moved to
you cannot ask a favour empty-handed
come back and tell me straight

quests.title: Bay 14, Yagoona
quests.blurb: Two hundred bays at Yagoona and I have counted two hundred and forty cars in here on grand final week. One of them has not moved since March and it has a ticket on it from March.

steps.label: the car, and the ticket, and the date on it
the two arguing over the grass
$78 in fines nobody is going to collect

quests.title: Whatever Is Under the Grey at Wynyard
quests.blurb: Council pays me to paint over things and last week I painted over something good. There is another one near Wynyard that I am scheduled to kill on the long weekend. Photograph it first.

steps.label: the wall, before they get to it
photograph it properly, not a phone-in-a-hurry job
show me

quests.title: The Hill Above Bella Vista
quests.blurb: There is a bench on the hill above Bella Vista I have watched from a moving bus about fourteen thousand times. I am not going to stop — that is not the kind of person I turned out to be. So you go, at half six, when the light is worth it.

steps.label: up the hill, the way the road does not go
the view I have never stopped for
$86, because I am paying you for it

quests.title: Contesting It at Gordon
quests.blurb: Two hundred and eighty-five dollars at Gordon for a thing the sign did not say, because the sign is not there. The form wants evidence. Go and photograph the absence.

steps.label: where the sign is supposed to be
photograph the absence, which is harder than it sounds
the one who tells you photography is not allowed here

quests.title: The Strip Outside Banksia
quests.blurb: Nobody planted the strip at Banksia. I did, on grand final week, at just gone midnight, so nobody would ask. I would like the fifteenth to go badly for council.

steps.label: the strip, which is a garden now
the man with the whipper snipper
photograph it while it still exists

quests.title: Night Fill, Mount Druitt
quests.blurb: Ten to six, nobody in the building but us and a radio that gets one station. Somebody has been taking things and they know our roster, which means they come in off the late train at Mount Druitt.

steps.label: come in on the late one like they do
the loading door nobody watches
whoever is standing in it at two in the morning
$71 of what they took, back

quests.title: The Window Above Kings Cross
quests.blurb: I live above the platform at Kings Cross and I know this line by sound. Something in the rhythm changed about a month ago and everyone I tell thinks I am mad. Ride it and tell me whether I am mad.

steps.label: ride it and listen to the joins
photograph the stretch that sounds wrong
tell me I am not mad

quests.title: Setting Up at Pennant Hills
quests.blurb: Five in the morning at Pennant Hills, in the dark, unloading a van by feel. The bloke in the next bay has started arriving at four to take half my frontage. I need a witness and I need them at four.

steps.label: the bays, at the hour it happens
the bloke with the extra trestle
you will want one at that hour
$64 of frontage, recovered

quests.title: The Clock at Church Street
quests.blurb: The clock on the Church Street platform has been four minutes fast since I got here and every relief who comes through wants to fix it. Do not fix it. Find out who set it that way, before they retire.

steps.label: the clock, four minutes fast, for the file
to Parramatta Square, where the old crew drink
bring the name back

quests.title: The Dog at Rhodes
quests.blurb: Sits at the yellow line at Rhodes at half six, waits, then walks off on its own. Half the platform knows and nobody has done anything, including me, and I am past being reasonable about it.

steps.label: the end of the platform, at twenty to six
the street it walks home to
tell me it is not a sad story

quests.title: The Book at Ngara
quests.blurb: Up four hundred over eleven weeks on the Ngara delay market. You cannot beat a delay book unless you can see the roster, and I have run out of ways to say it politely. Think about who can see the roster.

steps.label: ride the run they ride
the two who follow you off it
$83 back off the book

quests.title: Last Service out of Werrington
quests.blurb: The last one through Werrington carries four people and one of them is always asleep. Ride it to St Marys, photograph the platform with nobody on it, and come back and tell me the place still exists when there is no one in it.

steps.label: ride the late one to St Marys
the empty platform, lit and pointless
tell them what you saw

quests.title: The Rooty Hill Tap-Off
quests.blurb: Somebody taps on at Rooty Hill at two in the afternoon and never taps off. Same card, 11 months running. Ride the run they ride and find where a person gets off this network without a gate seeing them.

steps.label: ride the run the card rides
the gap in the fence everyone knows about
photograph it before somebody welds it

quests.title: The Waverton Order
quests.blurb: I have made the same order for the same person every morning since I opened at Waverton. Since the first of the month they have not turned up, and nobody upstairs wants to hear it. Go and knock.

steps.label: order one at the Waverton kiosk
the office they walk to, or used to
come back with $93 — I am not running a charity

quests.title: Four Minutes at Moore Park
quests.blurb: Nobody upstairs believes me about Moore Park because I have 7 years and no data. Go and stand on that platform on grand final week and get me the data, and nobody upstairs wants to hear it.

steps.label: stand under the board and wait like everyone else
photograph the board saying four minutes
ride the one that finally comes
give me the number
